The quiet web

By Autumn Brown

The best page on the internet is the one nobody is trying to monetise. It loads in a blink, it has no cookie banner, and it was written by a person who wanted to tell you something.

I keep a folder of them. A list of links that still work, with inline code where it helps.

A quote worth keeping, set apart from the argument around it.

On small things

Small sites do not need a design system. They need a paragraph, a date, and a way back to the index.

  • One idea per page
  • A date on every post
  • Links that outlive the author
make check

Field Notes, since 2019.
